title: Spaces block
brief: Redesign the Herdr Desktop Spaces block (top of the 300 px left sidebar, main Cmd+1..9 navigation) so it matches the approved calm language of 04-sessions-v2 and github 02-rich-tabs: machine groups with collapse and online state, repo/worktree nesting, branch, ahead/behind, dirty count, most urgent agent state with its task, shortcut numbers, a clear current space; AA contrast, icon + word states, visible #FFB547 focus, reduced motion.

artboards.title: Quiet list
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to 04: small-caps machine labels, two/three-line rows, outlined state pills and a soft raised selection with accent bar; most readable and harmonious, but tallest (~560 px for 7 visible spaces), so Agents start below the fold sooner

artboards.title: Repo tree
artboards.tradeoff: Makes repo → worktree structure and git state (branch, ↑/↓, dirty) explicit as quiet chips with agent program + state on the right; best for git-heavy work, but chips add visual texture and the block is about as tall as 01

artboards.title: Compact switcher
artboards.tradeoff: Densest (28 px rows led by ⌘ number, per-machine summary, ~360 px total) so Agents stay visible; branch and task appear only on hover/focus and for the current/urgent space, so idle git state is less scannable at a glance
